notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42300089/14fbf73281b2c3ab3f69e89526ff1e1e01b6e8b5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Update 1.1.0 has been released. [/h3][p]This update includes a wide variety of bug fixes, balance adjustments and quality-of-life improvements. Thank you to all who submitted feedback--your feedback makes a big difference! Suggested features and bugs reported by the community are marked with a ⭐.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]⭐ Stage Powerups now guide the player towards their location when within distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Style Points renamed to Positive Bonus. Getting a Positive Bonus will now trigger a visual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Powerup Chain Positive Bonus now triggers starting at x30 instead of x20.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced enemy count on certain waves on Foundation.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced enemy count on certain waves on Turbine and adjusted enemy spawn timings.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Slightly increased powerup visuals and hitbox size.[/p][/*][*][p]Green Weapon-1 gravity effect can now derail enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced Red Burst-A burn damage (could previously have triggered a feedback loop causing infinite damage under certain circumstances).[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased Yellow Burst-A damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased Orange Weapon-1 explosion damage and radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Blue Burst-A obstacle collision radius (hitting enemies remains unchanged but it is harder to accidentally collide with walls).[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Fixed softlock that would occur when going out-of-bounds using Blue Burst-A.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Blue Burst-B now uses the correct energy color.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ During boss spawn cutscenes, going out-of-bounds will now teleport the player onto the stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed homing projectile visual bug that would occur when an enemy is destroyed and preparing to shoot at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed Ether stage layout to reduce enemies getting stuck on the left side of the level.[/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Reduced Final Boss total health and adjusted health intervals.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Final Boss attack intervals.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Final Boss orange attack spawn radius and reduced explosion delay.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing red gate near the first wave in Final (to prevent players from advancing before completing the first wave).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Coming soon: more quality-of-life changes that didn't make it into this update, and more comprehensive changes to the finale sequence. Please stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Eric·ZDW[/p]

notes.title: CHROMA+ELEKTRON Early Access is Out Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42300089/c55928c95b1c2b7d751c1913a37bf94af8a9c3f6.png[/img]

[h3]CHROMA+ELEKTRON is now available for purchase in Early Access.[/h3]

Don't forget that feedback can be left via the Steam Discussions page. Any feedback is greatly appreciated and I hope to hear from you!

Thanks to everyone for your kind words and support thus far.
More updates are headed your way soon. Please stay tuned!


eric.zdw
